text:
maya: kicking off RC for the urgent search hotfix. created candidate: rc-search-511
alex: seeing deploy-bot notification now, can you confirm artifact sha?
maya: sha: 3f8a2b9c. built from main + cherrypick
kat: infra quick check: no infra changes in this RC, just model/config bump
deploy-bot: Candidate rc-search-511 created by maya at 1712349999. pin=3f8a2b9c. start window requested: now -> +30m
sam: i'm on the call. timeline? we planning staged canary
maya: yes. plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% over ~20min with telemetry gates. KV warm step included
alex: rollback plan? share commands
maya: rollback = revert pin in routing + restart canary; quick command:
```
# rollback to previous
redwood deploy set-pin --route /search --model pin:prev-2026-03-21
redwood traffic shift --route /search --to default --percent 100
```
kat: also have infra escape hatch: `kubectl scale deployment search-api --replicas=3` if autoscale stalls
smoke-bot: smoke tests queued (suite: search-basic, search-latency). will report in 90s
maya: pre-smoke manual checks done: db migrations none, config diff clean
sam: request sheriff ack for radio-silence during promo (15m)
alex: ack from me for radio silence + on-call monitor
deploy-bot: Scheduling canary: 2% for 3m, then 10% for 7m, then 50% for 10m. KV warm step at 2% complete hook.
maya: starting canary now. tagging release notes: "fix: search ranking regression in multi-token queries"
kat: note: watch redis hit rates during KV warm. alert if >80% miss for 1m
smoke-bot: smoke results: search-basic OK, latency within 5th pct baseline
alex: telemetry: request traces for high-error-rate endpoints /search/stream and /search/aggregate
maya: canary at 2% -> warming KV. small spike in p95 expected
sam: if metrics pass, i'll greenlight 10% step. otherwise, rollforward (keep small traffic but rollback artifact) to minimize impact
alex: sheriff on standby. if errors >1% for 5m, we execute rollback command above and flip traffic
maya: 10% -> holding for metrics, nothing concerning so far :thumbsup:
smoke-bot: canary 2% -> 10% transition logged at 1712349988
maya: promo to 50% in 5m once 10% looks stable
deploy-bot: promo checklist: artifact pinned, smoke green, sheriff ack, rollout window set, rollback command saved, docs updated
sam: documenting release note in repo under releases/rc-search-511.md
alex: post-promo: run a quick eval against canary promptset to ensure ranking quality hasn't regressed
maya: confirmed. doing eval after 50% lift. if any regression, we'll rollforward to previous model and throttle traffic
kat: leaving monitoring hooks on for 30m post-promo. i'll coordinate escalation if infra shows pressure
maya: thanks team. calling radio-silence for 15m starting now :rotating_light:
alex: ack
sam: greenlighted. proceeding with promotion window
deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% initiated at 1712350200. will auto-advance if gates pass."
